$schema.description: Schema URL for editor validation; read and ignored.

driver.description: Which driver call uses: the run driver, a plan driver, or none.

drivers.description: Per-driver settings; only agent-browser runs outside the agent session.

agent-browser.description: How to reach agent-browser: command, session, and how to show it.

command.description: Program to run; user config only, never the project file.

session.description: Named session to reuse, so logins persist across calls.

headed.description: Show the browser window instead of running headless.

profile.description: Logged-in Chrome profile dir; user config only.

cdp.description: Attach to a running Chrome; user config only.

call.description: Call-wide settings shared by every driver.

timeout.description: How long one tool call may take, in milliseconds.

permissions.description: Tool patterns governing whether a call runs, asks, or is refused.

deny.description: Patterns never called; deny wins over ask and allow.
